items.evidence: 11 of 23 routes differ: mareaOverview 13 vs 4; mareaFamilyWeather 9 vs 10 (matrix adds GATE-MARKET-PLACEMENT); mareaSolutionStart/Cruise 11 vs 12 and mareaSolutionSail 12 vs 13 (matrix adds GATE-PRIVACY-DPA-DPIA); mareaSolutionProtect 12 vs 11 (registry adds GATE-SAFETY-PILOT); mareaConfigurator 12 vs 5; professionals/installers 5 vs 6; support 5 vs 6; productDocumentation 7 vs 7 with a different composition (registry SAFETY+DATA, matrix CONSUMER-TERMS+MARKET-PLACEMENT). proposed-routes.json and proposed-ia.json agree with each other (0 differences) and both disagree with routeGateMatrix. D05 MC15-PROPOSED-ROUTE-REGISTRY.md:77-107 documents the productFamilyIds/bundleIds derivation; D13 MC15-LEGAL-COMMERCIAL-PUBLICATION-GATES.md:142-150 declares the matrix the exact blockingGateIds and explains only matrix-vs-gate-scope, not registry-vs-matrix. The validator checks id existence only, never set equality. Both lists are plausible to an implementer, one over-blocks and the other under-blocks.
items.requiredCorrection: Choose one authoritative blocking-gate derivation (or define two explicitly named fields with a documented relationship), regenerate proposed-routes.json, proposed-ia.json and routeGateMatrix from it, reconcile D05 and D13, and add a validator equality rule (and unit test) so the datasets cannot diverge again. Do not close or relax any gate.

items.reproduction: node -e "(async()=>{const r=await fetch('http://127.0.0.1:4399/productos/does-not-exist');const t=await r.text();console.log(r.status,r.headers.get('location'),t.length,/<meta name=\"robots\"/.test(t));})()" against an isolated local SSR run (dist build, disposable DATA_DIR).
items.evidence: redirect-map.json:1069 records '/productos/does-not-exist -> 404 at the source URL with no Location header' (also :1286) and :1297 records '404, zero redirect hops'. The reproduced response is HTTP 404 WITH 'Location: /tecnologia/does-not-exist', an empty body (0 bytes) and no noindex meta; /no-existe, /marea and /tienda/no-existe return a 404 with a noindex body and no Location. The inherited Angular route redirect leaves a Location header on the empty 404 for unknown legacy product slugs. The important invariant (no 301 to a 404 destination; unknown slug is not 301-redirected) still holds, but the recorded observation is inaccurate and the empty-body 404 bypasses the documented NotFound noindex surface.
items.requiredCorrection: Correct the D07 observation wording and add the inherited empty-body 404 + Location behaviour to the D02/D07 observations (and to nonRedirectSurfaces), explicitly stating it is not a redirect and is out of MC-15 change scope. Do not change live routing in MC-15.
